name: emit
description: Report one line and finish this turn. On the call that ends the job, set finish=true and put the full execution record in summary -- that single call ends the job and is the deliverable.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: ONE line of board state (done/total, in flight, next); the FULL execution record when finish=true

parameters.name: finish
parameters.description: true only on the call that ends the job, when every board task is done and verified
